thread:
Ava (Content): Ok team — kicking off the community launch for the new open-source "Edge Deploy Kit". Scope: OSS blog post, short benchmark highlight, a 45-minute webinar with a 30-minute hands-on lab, and a developer-focused tweet thread. :tada:
Priya (DevRel): Nice. For the lab let's keep it runnable in 20–30 minutes: repo walkthrough, quick local deploy, run a tiny perf check with our bench script. Make steps copy-paste friendly.
Liam (PM): Bench narrative should show real tradeoffs: p90 latency @512 tokens, median tokens/sec, and cost delta vs hosted API on small-batch workloads. Target: make claims reproducible with our bench CSV.
Noah (SRE): I'll run a small matrix (GPU-like and CPU-edge sim) and drop a CSV + minimal charts. Also preparing a tiny Docker image and a single-file k8s manifest for the lab. Quick telemetry snippet for the repo:
```
export RW_API_KEY="$RW_KEY"
./bench/edge-bench --model rwd-mini --tokens 512 --concurrency 4
```
Priya (DevRel): Repo layout proposal: /quickstart, /bench, /deploy-templates, /workshop, /troubleshooting. Add a lab checklist with expected outputs so attendees can self-verify.
Evelyn (Growth): Landing page + CTA must use utm=oss_edge_launch and feed into HubSpot. Promo plan: organic + paid day-of, two reminder emails, and a post-webinar nurture flow. Need 2 exec quotes for press and a compact tweet thread.
Ava (Content): Draft headline idea: "Edge Deploy Kit — Lightweight starter for private LLM inference." Will put together blog + 3-part tweet thread: what it is, bench highlight, workshop CTA. Draft by EOD Friday.
Priya (DevRel): Speakers: Priya + Liam + Noah. Agenda: 20-min demo, 15-min bench walkthrough, 10-min live Q&A, 30-min optional lab breakout. Record and publish to YT + link to repo with actions to auto-run bench.
Noah (SRE): Action items: 1) bench runs and CSV, 2) docker image and k8s manifest, 3) telemetry snippet and readme. I'll upload artifacts to /bench tomorrow morning.
launch-bot: Reminder: schedule webinar at least 3 weeks out. Use template "webinar-standard" to auto-create Zoom and registration page.
Evelyn (Growth): Timeline: week 1 blog + repo skeleton, week 2 bench + artifacts, week 3 webinar + promos. HubSpot workflow: utm_source=oss_edge_launch -> list "OSS Edge Registrants"; attended -> tag oss_edge:attended; >2 email opens -> mark as warm and notify AE.
Liam (PM): Inbound routing note: map registrants to oss_edge leadflow, tag by attended vs registered. If warmed, escalate to AE channel. Also we should include a 3-question pre-webinar survey to tailor breakout labs.
Ava (Content): Tiny demo snippet for the blog (short):
```
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 redwood/edge-deploy-kit:latest
# then
curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"Summarize this repo"}'
```
Priya (DevRel): Also include a troubleshooting section: common docker errors, CPU fallback tips, and a minimal quantized-model strategy.
Noah (SRE): I'll add a short k8s manifest and a telemetry example that prints latency and tokens/sec to stdout for the lab.
Ava (Content): Summary of owners: Ava -> blog + tweets; Priya -> repo + lab guide; Noah -> bench + docker + k8s; Liam -> speaker notes + bench narrative; Evelyn -> landing page + HubSpot + promos. I'll assemble a launch checklist once first drafts are up.
Liam (PM): Let's do a dry-run one week before the webinar. Ping me when drafts are ready.
Evelyn (Growth): Booking calendar now and setting reminders. I'll wire the registrant tagging and post-webinar nurture.
Ava (Content): Any blockers?
Priya (DevRel): Starting repo skeleton now, no blockers.
Noah (SRE): Bench run scheduled tomorrow AM, will post results here.
Ava (Content): Great — keeping this thread as source-of-truth. Thanks everyone :rocket:
